address: Politiepost IJburg, IJburglaan 1397, Amsterdam (2004; ground-floor police post in a red-brick housing block, one pand)
notes: 2004 housing block on IJburglaan with the Politiepost IJburg (103 LoD2.2 wall surfaces, 63 m SW front); the pand is the whole block and the police post is its ground-floor unit. SW front from the 2022-05-13 panorama (w01-221, 13 m away, rectified): at the right a six-storey red-brick tower with railings behind white frames and a two-storey open gate portal under a flat concrete slab; at the left a four-storey brick base with a glass shopfront ground floor, orange-painted entrance boxes and a blue diamond police sign (the post), under a steel and timber-louvre loggia level that steps back. SE end (2021-02-04, w04-131, from across the canal): the same brick, seven rows of paired windows, shutters at the ground.

Ornaments from the panorama: blue diamond police blade sign by the post doors (SIMPLIFIED as the kit blue lamp beside the post entrance: same colour and position, a box not a diamond); orange entrance boxes at the post (door colour orange MODELLED as the entrance door, the projecting orange box is SIMPLIFIED: recessed door); P-politie parking signs (SKIPPED: street furniture on poles); open gate portal under a concrete slab (MODELLED as a two-storey entrance hall with a canopy); no POLITIE lettering on the building (the sign is the blade), no striped band or crest; steel and louvre loggia at the left upper levels (SKIPPED: a 4 m deep open frame structure with slatted shutters, not in the 3DBAG volume above the plinth line, which the loggia surfaces 44/39/75 already take as flat walls left blank).

Surface 35 (7.7 m of the tower front, 33.5 to 41.2 m along the panel) is left blank: grouping it with surface 72 gives 0.4 m2 coplanar sill/reveal overlap at audit:glb (zfight-m2 above the zero baseline). The entrance hall is bay 2 of 6 of the tower group; the gate portal in the photo is at the right of the tower, so it sits about 6 m left of its real position. North-east, north-west and courtyard walls have no panorama (candidates 0) and stay blank.
